newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian/US 10-yr bond spread blows out.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian/US 10-yr bond spread blows out.

text.p: The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread blew out sharply as the local market suffered its first real correction in some weeks.

The market had tested the 125 basis point spread low in early trading following a sell-off in U.S. Treasuries on Friday, but a break of the 8.0 percent yield on the local benchmark 10-year bond late in the day saw domestic bonds quickly lose ground, traders said.
This margin stood at 140 basis points after last week's budget and at around 160 basis points on the July 31 cut in official interest rates to 7.0 percent.
Stronger than expected U.S. July durable goods orders had sent the U.S. bond market reeling on Friday on reignited U.S. economic growth fears.
The local long-end also underperformed other dollar bloc bonds, particularly the Canadian market which outpaced the U.S. on Friday based on its currently more market friendly fundamentals.
